name: Lucid Theme
description: Lucid: three light, readable themes for EspoCRM (Lucid, Lucid Monochrome, Lucid Brut). Record view with an owner and pipeline band, collapsible blocks, adjustable columns and an activity stream, in two layouts (Split, fields beside activity, or Classic), light and dark palettes and two densities, chosen from the top bar. Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA / RGAA). https://github.com/AlexisSantin/espocrm-lucid-theme
author: Alexis SANTIN
